phase: Proposed class settlement awaiting approval decision
phaseDetail: The King v. Monsanto fairness hearing was held September 14, 2026. The official administrator says the court will now decide whether to approve the settlement and that the timing is unknown. The separate federal MDL remains before Judge Vince Chhabria.

settlements.label: King v. Monsanto proposed class settlement
settlements.detail: The proposed King v. Monsanto class settlement provides up to $7.25 billion, subject to final approval. The fairness hearing was held September 14, 2026; the administrator says the court will now decide whether to approve the settlement and that the timing is unknown. June 4 objection and opt-out deadlines have passed.
settlements.individualClaims: Class terms and later approval events control; no automatic individual award.

keyDates.label: Supreme Court decision in Monsanto v. Durnell
keyDates.detail: The Supreme Court held that FIFRA expressly preempted the state-law label-based failure-to-warn claim at issue in No. 24-1068.
